clips.title: The story
paras: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg is an Alliance quest authorized by the Sentinels to curb the aggressive furbolg population corrupting Teldrassil. Shayla Nightbreeze recruits adventurers outside Darnassus to hunt the corrupted beasts and collect their fangs as proof of deed.

On the road outside Darnassus, Shayla Nightbreeze acts on direct orders from the Sentinels to place a bounty on the Gnarlpine furbolg. Once peaceful inhabitants of the ancient forests, the Gnarlpine have succumbed to a spreading corruption that stripped away their reason, turning them into vicious threats to the safety of travelers and the natural sanctity of Teldrassil.

To curb the Gnarlpine aggression, hunters are dispatched across the boughs of the World Tree to cull their ranks and collect their fangs as proof. The bulk of their corrupted population resides in two major strongholds: Ban'ethil Hollow, set south of the road west of Dolanaar, and the ruins of Starbreeze Village toward the east.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.
As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.
You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have served well, friend. You shall be rewarded for your contribution.
